lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are arranged in multiple horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. In the central lateral region, three prominent maxima form a triangular configuration with relatively uniform spacing between centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows; several high-luminance blobs are positioned at these junctions, creating a discernible grid-like arrangement of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal feature is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the dorsal edge and deep shadow on the ventral edge, running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated, fusiform silhouette is attached to the ventral profile of the shark, posterior to the pectoral fin's trailing edge.
